title: Deterministic oracle time is contained in nondeterministic oracle time
statement: For every language $O$ over $\{0,1\}$, every language decidable in polynomial time by a deterministic Turing machine with oracle access to $O$ is also decidable in polynomial time by a nondeterministic Turing machine with the same oracle; equivalently, $	ext{P}^O\subseteq\text{NP}^O$.
hypotheses_covered: $O$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
